Second Coat: London for the PS5 (homebrew title): The Getaway (PS2), remastered.

Bring your own disc image: put it at /data/secondcoatlondon/game.iso.

This title contains the following third-party code, under the notices below:

  - RADV and the parts of Mesa it is built with (https://mesa3d.org/,
    the PS5 port https://github.com/mihawk-99/PS5_Mesa): the MIT License;
    its Berkeley SoftFloat code: a BSD 3-clause licence; also zlib (the
    zlib licence) and BLAKE3 (used under CC0-1.0), which ask for no notice.
  - musl's regular-expression engine (https://musl.libc.org/): the MIT
    License; the TRE code it is based on: a BSD 2-clause licence.
  - LLVM's libc++, libc++abi, libunwind and compiler-rt builtins:
    Apache-2.0 WITH LLVM-exception, which asks for no notice in a binary.

The Rust crates in it, with their licences: THIRD-PARTY-LICENSES.txt.
